name: Which Quantization Should I Use? A Unified Evaluation of llama.cpp Quantization on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (Kurt, 2026)
notes: Unified llama.cpp GGUF quantization eval on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Tables 2/3 read directly: WikiText-2 ppl and 5-benchmark scores for 13 quant configs vs an F16 baseline, and pp512/tg128 CPU throughput at fixed settings.
